leadText:
Pokémon: Paldean Winds (Japanese: 放課後のブレス After-School Breath) is an miniseries based on Pokémon Scarlet and Violet set in the Paldea region. It consists of 4 episodes.

It premiered on September 6, 2023 on the official Japanese, English, and Asian YouTube channels and on September 29, 2023 on the official European YouTube channels. It was announced worldwide on August 8, 2023 through Pokémon Presents.
plainText:
Pokémon: Paldean Winds (Japanese: 放課後のブレス After-School Breath) is an miniseries based on Pokémon Scarlet and Violet set in the Paldea region. It consists of 4 episodes.

It premiered on September 6, 2023 on the official Japanese, English, and Asian YouTube channels and on September 29, 2023 on the official European YouTube channels. It was announced worldwide on August 8, 2023 through Pokémon Presents.

==Blurb==
Pokémon: Paldean Winds is set in the Paldea region and tells the story of three academy students—Ohara, Aliquis, and Hohma—as they pursue their respective dreams.

==Plot==
The series follows the lives of three students at Naranja Academy, who have been given the project of making a video about the academy for new students by Director Clavell. Each of the students has their own struggles, with Ohara feeling overwhelmed by her role in the band club, Aliquis trying to defeat his rival Nemona, and Hohma trying to find a great story for the journalism club.
